desc.en: Also known as the Assassins of the Desert, these monsters have sickles on both arms. They bury themselves in the sand, then cut their prey down in an instant when they pass nearby. They are occasionally seen wandering about aimlessly.
desc.ja: 別名、砂漠の暗殺者と呼ばれる両手にカマを持った魔物。砂の中に潜んで、近づいた獲物を一瞬で仕留める。たまに、不用意に徘徊している事がある
